item.summary: fix(plugin-sdk): make the API baseline contract path-free and surface-reachable (#121514) * fix(plugin-sdk): make the API baseline hash path-free and surface-reachable Manifest hashes now cover only surface-reachable, path-independent facts. Rewrite closure from whole-file/path-keyed traversal to declaration-granular reachability with fail-toward-recall fallbacks and taint-tracked cycles. Exclude source paths from the committed hash and split declaration printing into api-baseline-declaration-print.ts. * fix(plugin-sdk): close side-effect and namespace-import gaps in baseline closure Address ClawSweeper findings: - Traverse side-effect imports before collecting globals. - Normalize repo-owned namespace import types. * refactor(plugin-sdk): rebase precision closure onto the JSONL contract
